description: Dynea Pakistan Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 20 June 1982 and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It manufactures and sells formaldehyde, urea and melamine formaldehyde resins, and moulding compounds, with a dedicated division for formaldehyde and wood-based resins and a factory at Gadoon. The company began as Dyno Pakistan and adopted the Dynea name in 2001; it states that its emphasis is on moulding compounds.
